description: JVM descriptor and cross-feature integration join (ISSUE-0110). These fixtures run the real DEAL frontend (lexer → parser → name resolver → type checker) → real JvmBackend codegen → javac → java subprocess executing the emitted artifact (the harness fails a fixture whose codegen or JVM execution is bypassed; the multi-module fixtures additionally run the real CompilationOrchestrator pipeline). Covered forms: nested descriptors (?[int], [?int], ?[Pt], [?Pt], ?[?int]) through function parameters and returns; nullable arrays and classes through parameters/returns; function signatures combining arrays, classes, and nullability ([int], ?Pair, ?[string]); imported nominal classes in descriptors (param p: @lib/Point, let i: @lib/Item); deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostics pinned byte-for-byte at the single shared descriptor-driven $check(descriptor, value) seam ('expected int, got String', 'expected instance of @Main/B, got @Main/A', 'expected array, got __StringArray' at [int] and ?[int] gates, 'expected instance of @modelb/Item, got @modela/Item' across modules); the table branch; and a stdlib boundary (std/string results flowing into nullable locals). Three IR-layer fixtures pin the descriptor forms whose runtime lanes land later: the nested array [[int]], the async completion descriptor async(int)->string with the async-completion boundary, and the function-type descriptor ([int],?@mod/User)->?@mod/User.

tests.name: jvm-join-nullable-array-param-return
tests.description: Cross-feature join: an int[] | null value (descriptor ?[int]) flows through a function parameter and return, null and array both round-trip, and the caller narrows each result (7 + 1 = 8)

tests.name: jvm-join-nullable-elements-array-desc
tests.description: Cross-feature join: an (int | null)[] array (descriptor [?int]) is built from null and int elements, passed as a parameter, iterated, and each element narrows in the loop (1 + 3 = 4)

tests.name: jvm-join-nullable-class-param-return
tests.description: Cross-feature join: a User | null value (descriptor ?User) flows through a function parameter and return; the class value and the null side both round-trip and branch correctly

tests.name: jvm-join-fn-signature-arrays-classes-nullable
tests.description: Cross-feature join: one function signature combines an int[] parameter, a Pair | null parameter, and a string[] | null parameter (descriptors [int], ?Pair, ?[string]); the nullable return narrows at the call site (5 + 4 + 1 = 10)

tests.name: jvm-join-class-array-param-return
tests.description: Cross-feature join: a Pt[] class array (descriptor [Pt]) is built from constructed instances, passed as a parameter, returned, and its element field reads back (30)

tests.name: jvm-join-nullable-class-array-desc
tests.description: Cross-feature join: a (Pt | null)[] array (descriptor [?Pt]) holds class instances and null elements, passes as a parameter, and each element narrows for the field read (1 + 2 = 3)

tests.name: jvm-join-nullable-class-array-param-return
tests.description: Cross-feature join: a Pt[] | null value (descriptor ?[Pt]) flows through a function parameter and return; the array side yields its first element and the null side yields null (9 + 1 = 10)

tests.name: jvm-join-nullable-of-nullable-elements
tests.description: Cross-feature join: the nested descriptor ?[?int] — an (int | null)[] | null value — passes as a parameter; the null side yields -1 and the array side sums its non-null elements (2 + -1 + 3 = 4)

tests.name: jvm-join-mismatch-nullable-int
tests.description: Deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostic at the shared seam: a string value crossing an int | null table-read boundary raises E8001 with the exact message 'expected int, got String' and exit 1

tests.name: jvm-join-mismatch-nullable-class
tests.description: Deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostic at the shared seam: an A instance crossing a B | null table-read boundary raises E8001 naming both module-qualified identities ('expected instance of @Main/B, got @Main/A') and exit 1

tests.name: jvm-join-mismatch-array-wrapper
tests.description: Deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostic at the shared seam: a string[] wrapper crossing an int[] table-read boundary raises E8001 'expected array, got __StringArray' and exit 1 (the [int] branch gates on the emitted wrapper)

tests.name: jvm-join-mismatch-nullable-array-gate
tests.description: Deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostic at the shared seam: a string[] wrapper crossing an int[] | null table-read boundary raises E8001 'expected array, got __StringArray' and exit 1 (the ? prefix passes only the DEAL null before the [int] gate)

tests.name: jvm-join-table-desc
tests.description: Cross-feature join: a nested table round-trips through the shared seam's table branch (descriptor 'table') — the table-typed read passes the gate and the artifact runs

tests.name: jvm-join-stdlib-nullable-boundary
tests.description: Cross-feature join at a supported stdlib boundary: std/string results flow into nullable locals and narrow for the arithmetic/equality checks (str.length('abc') = 3, str.substring('abcdef', 2, 4) = 'cd' → 3 + 1 = 4)

tests.name: jvm-join-xmod-class-descriptor
tests.description: Cross-feature join across modules: an imported nominal class appears in descriptors — the entry-local function's parameter spells the spec class descriptor @lib/Point in the IR, the value flows in and out of an entry-local function, and the field reads back (7)

modules.lib.deal:
export class Point { x: int = 0; }
export function make(x: int): Point { return { x: x }; }

tests.name: jvm-join-xmod-table-read-desc
tests.description: Cross-feature join across modules: an imported nominal class crosses the untyped table boundary — the read dispatches on the DECLARING module's shared seam with the spec class descriptor @lib/Item (the IR spells the resolved read type @lib/Item) and the field reads back ('x')

modules.lib.deal:
export class Item { tag: string = ""; }
export function make(tag: string): Item { return { tag: tag }; }

tests.name: jvm-join-xmod-mismatch-desc
tests.description: Deterministic runtime mismatch diagnostic at the shared seam across modules: a modela.Item instance crossing a modelb.Item table-read boundary dispatches on the declaring module's seam and raises E8001 naming both module-qualified identities ('expected instance of @modelb/Item, got @modela/Item') and exit 1

modules.modela.deal:
export class Item { tag: string = ""; }
export function make(tag: string): Item { return { tag: tag }; }

tests.name: jvm-join-nested-array-descriptor-ir
tests.description: Descriptor-form coverage at the IR layer: a nested int[][] parameter spells the spec descriptor [[int]] (nested arrays stay E6000 at JVM codegen in this slice, so this fixture pins the descriptor spelling the frontend/IR pipeline produces for the later lanes)

tests.name: jvm-join-async-completion-descriptor-ir
tests.description: Async completion descriptor coverage at the IR layer: an async function declaration and its async function-typed value spell the spec descriptor async(int)->string, and the return inside the async body carries the async-completion boundary (the JVM async slice ISSUE-0099 consumes this seam; async functions stay E6000 at JVM codegen in this slice)
tests.source:
async function fetch(x: int): string { return "s"; }
let f: async (x: int) => string = fetch;

tests.name: jvm-join-function-type-descriptor-ir
tests.description: Function-signature descriptor coverage at the IR layer: a function type whose parameters and return combine an array, a nullable class, and nullability spells the nested spec descriptor ([int],?@mod/User)->?@mod/User on the function-typed value (function values stay E6000 at JVM codegen in this slice; the ISSUE-0098 function-value slice consumes this seam)
